raw_response:
I am 49 years old. I have farmed for 30 years. I never went to school, not one day. I learned everything by standing in the field and watching what happens. I farm 12 mu of cotton here in Quzhou County, just me and my wife. Two people can handle 12 mu if we get up early and do not waste time sitting around.

I do not trust outsiders who tell me what to do. I trust my eyes. If my neighbor Lao Wang's cotton looks good, I copy what he did. Last year I planted zhongmian608, 3 jin of seed per mu. I bought 36 jin total for the whole field. The seed dealer sells it and everyone around here plants it, so I plant it too. I do not know if it is a hybrid — the dealer says it is improved, and that is good enough for me. Last year I got about 600 jin of seed cotton per mu. This year if the weather is normal, I will get the same.

For fertilizer, I use 100 jin of special compound fertilizer per mu. That is half a 50 kg bag for each mu. For 12 mu I need 12 bags. The bag has numbers on it — 18, 22, 5 — but I cannot read them. The dealer told me this bag is made for cotton, and I saw Lao Wang's cotton grow dark green when he used it, so I use it too. I do not buy extra urea or phosphate by themselves. One bag has everything in it. Spending money on more bags means less money for pesticide, and the cotton needs to eat. I would rather put too much fertilizer than too little. A bad harvest means disaster; wasting a little fertilizer is just money gone.

I have a well. I irrigate twice. First time is after sowing if the spring is dry. Second time is when the bolls are forming and the heat comes. Two times is enough if the rain helps. More watering means more electricity, and I need to save money for spraying medicine.

I spray insecticide 12 times, starting when the first flowers open, then every 7 to 10 days. The bollworm never sleeps. I also spray herbicide once after sowing so the weeds do not choke the young plants, and I spray growth regulator three times so the plants do not grow too tall and fall over. I do all the spraying myself with a backpack sprayer.

I till the field with a rotary tiller. I hire the machine. It costs 30 yuan per mu. Ploughing is slower and costs more, so I do rotary.

I think about money every day. Seeds, fertilizer, diesel for the pump, medicine — every yuan is real. But I would rather spend a little more than lose the crop. I watched what happened to Old Zhang two years ago when he tried to save money on fertilizer. His bolls were small like peas. I cannot let that happen to me. I watch my neighbors. If they buy something new, I wait one year and watch their field. If it works, maybe I try it. This year, I will do what I did last year. Last year worked.
